header.title: Aspect Ratio
header.description: Keeps a fixed proportion (width : height) no matter how much width is available. Use it for images, videos, embeds and placeholders: it reserves the space before the content loads and prevents layout shifts. Content is centered, and images or videos are cropped according to `objectFit`.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and see the result and code instantly. Try the square image with `objectFit="contain"` to see the background around it.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Without props, the ratio is 16:9. The container takes the full available width and computes the height; here `maxWidth={640}` caps the width. The image is a direct child of the inner box, so it is cropped with `object-fit: cover`. The examples use these demo styles.

presets.title: Preset ratios
presets.description: `ratio` accepts presets like `"1:1"`, `"4:3"` or `"9:16"`, and also names. The table lists the available names and the ratio each one maps to.

card.title: Cards
card.description: `ratio="tcg"`, `"2.5:3.5"` and `"5:7"` give the same card format. With `maxWidth` they all share the same width and, since the ratio is fixed, the same height too.

custom.title: Custom ratio
custom.description: Besides presets, `ratio` accepts `"W:H"`, `"W/H"`, `"WxH"`, a decimal number (`1.618`) or a `{ width, height }` object. Invalid values fall back to 16:9. Type a value and apply it: the text above shows what `resolveAspectRatio` returns.

objectFit.title: Image fit
objectFit.description: `objectFit` sets how the image adapts to the box: `cover` (default) crops, `contain` shows it whole with background around it, `fill` stretches it, `none` keeps the original size and `scale-down` picks the smaller of `none` and `contain`. It only affects `img`, `video`, `iframe`, `canvas` and `svg` direct children.

objectPosition.title: Image position
objectPosition.description: When the image is cropped, `objectPosition` picks which part stays visible. It accepts any `object-position` value: keywords (`left`, `top right`) or percentages (`"30% 50%"`).

placeholder.title: Placeholder while loading
placeholder.description: Since the space is already reserved, you can show a placeholder over the image until it finishes loading, and the page doesn't jump. Loading is delayed a bit so you can notice it; press the button to repeat it.

embed.title: Embeds
embed.description: A direct `iframe` child fills the whole box, ideal for embedded videos or maps. Give it a `title` so screen readers announce it.

texts.title: Sample embedded content
texts.body: This content lives inside an iframe.

radius.title: Rounded corners
radius.description: `radius` uses the gem-system token scale; it defaults to `md`. With `full` and `ratio="1:1"` you get a circle, handy for avatars.

maxWidth.title: Max width
maxWidth.description: `maxWidth` caps the width and, because of the ratio, the height as well. A number is read as pixels and a string as a CSS length (`"60%"`, `"20rem"`). It doesn't center the box: add `mx-auto` for that.

figure.title: With figure and caption
figure.description: For an image with a caption, wrap the AspectRatio in a `figure` and put the caption in a `figcaption` outside the box, so it isn't cropped and doesn't cover the image.
figure.caption: gem-system banner in photo format (3:2).

header.title: AspectRatio API
header.description: API reference for the AspectRatio React component: props, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens, utilities and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath, which also exports `toCssLength`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTML attributes (HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>) and forwards them to the root element. ref reaches the root element. ratio, objectFit, objectPosition and maxWidth become CSS variables inside style, merged with the style you pass. Children render inside .gem-aspect-ratio__inner.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.alt: AspectRatio adds no semantics: the image inside needs its own alt describing the content.
a11y.decorative: If the image is decorative, use alt="" so screen readers skip it.
a11y.iframe: An iframe needs a title so its content is announced.
a11y.figure: For images with a caption use figure and figcaption, keeping the caption outside the box so it isn't cropped.
a11y.landmark: With as you can render figure, section or article instead of a <div>.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root element. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`. Has `width: 100%`, the ratio, the radius and the `--gem-color-bg-subtle` background.
rules.radius: Applied according to `radius`. Sets `--gem-aspect-ratio-radius` to the matching token.
rules.inner: Absolute inner box that fills the space and centers the content. Receives `classNames.inner`.
rules.media: Direct media children: they fill the box and use `object-fit` and `object-position`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: The ratio, fit, position and max width are written inline, so they can only be overridden with `!important` (this site's Tailwind utilities already use it). The radius comes from the `radius` class and can be changed from your own class such as `.gem-aspect-ratio.my-class`.

items.--gem-aspect-ratio-fit: `object-fit` value for media children. Set by `objectFit`.
items.--gem-aspect-ratio-position: `object-position` value for media children. Set by `objectPosition`.
items.--gem-aspect-ratio-max: Max width of the root element. Set by `maxWidth`; without it there is no limit.
items.--gem-aspect-ratio-radius: Border radius. Set by the `radius` class.

items.--gem-color-bg-subtle: Box background; visible around the content with `contain` or while loading.

utils.title: Utilities
utils.description: Functions and constants exported alongside the component.

items.resolveAspectRatio: Turns any value accepted by `ratio` into the CSS `aspect-ratio` value (for example `"4:3"` → `"4 / 3"`). Invalid values return `DEFAULT_ASPECT_RATIO`.
items.DEFAULT_ASPECT_RATIO: Ratio used when `ratio` is missing or invalid.
items.toCssLength: Turns a number into pixels (`320` → `"320px"`) and leaves strings as they are. It's what `maxWidth` uses.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of the root element.

items.ratio: Ratio: preset, `"W:H"`, `"W/H"`, `"WxH"`, decimal number or `{ width, height }` object. Invalid values fall back to 16:9.
items.objectFit: How media children adapt to the box (`object-fit`).
items.objectPosition: Which part of media children stays visible when cropped (`object-position`).
items.radius: Border radius from the token scale.
items.maxWidth: Max width. A number is read as pixels and a string as a CSS length. It doesn't center the element.
items.className: Extra classes for the root element.
items.classNames: Per-slot classes: `root` for the root element and `inner` for the inner box.
items.style: Inline styles. Merged with the component's CSS variables.
items.children: Box content. Images, videos and iframes must be direct children to fill the space.
